description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic and mortality information for patients within the dataset. It includes unique patient identifiers, gender, date of birth, and date of death information from various sources (hospital records, Social Security Administration). The table also includes an expire flag to indicate record status.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the dataset.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: Patient's gender, recorded as either 'F' (female) or 'M' (male).

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: Date of birth of the patient.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: Date of death of the patient.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: Date of death recorded by the hospital.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: Date of death recorded by the Social Security Administration.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the patient's record has expired. 0 indicates the record is active, 1 indicates the record is expired.
